title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

  → Guarantees the bank a baseline charge even on small international withdrawals.

  → Introduces the account's key value proposition: certain ATM fees are automatically refunded to the customer.

6. **The monthly rebate cap for out-of-network ATM fees is $25.**
  → Sets a clear upper limit on how much fee reimbursement a customer can receive each month.

7. **Rebates are applied only until the monthly cap is reached.**
  → Clarifies the mechanics of the rebate program—reimbursement stops once the $25 threshold is hit.

8. **Eligible fees exceeding the $25 monthly cap are the account holder's responsibility.**
  → Warns that heavy out-of-network usage beyond the cap results in out-of-pocket costs for the customer.

  → Highlights the convenience of the program: rebates are automatic, with no claims or requests required.

  → Explains how customers can verify rebates on their statements, since charges and credits are listed distinctly.

  → Defines eligibility for the cap: only fees actually charged to the account for out-of-network usage apply.

  → Resolves ambiguity in the foreign fee formula: the minimum acts as a floor whenever 1.5% falls below $2.50.

  → Specifies the timing of the charge for international withdrawals, so customers know when to expect it.

  → Offers practical advice: fewer ATM trips directly lower the accumulated $1.00 fees.

  → Encourages proactive tracking so customers understand how much rebate protection remains in a given month.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Foreign withdrawal:

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

[END]

Which types of ATM fees qualify for rebates under the Lime Green Account, and is there any limit on the rebate?
[END]
[ANSWER]
Eligible out-of-network ATM fees qualify for rebates under the Lime Green Account, but the total rebate is capped at $25 per month.
[END]

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

## Examples

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.

title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
content:
## ATM Access

- You can use out-of-network ATMs for cash withdrawals. Each out-of-network ATM transaction is assessed a fee of $1.00.
- International (foreign) ATM withdrawals incur a fee equal to 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50 per withdrawal.

### Quick reference

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Out-of-network ATM transaction fee (domestic) | $1.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 1.5% of amount; minimum $2.50 |
| Monthly ATM fee rebate cap (out-of-network usage) | Up to $25 per month |

## ATM Fee Rebates

- Your account provides monthly rebates of eligible fees from out-of-network ATM usage, up to $25 per month.
- Rebates are applied until the monthly cap is reached; any eligible fees above the cap are your responsibility.
- You do not need to take additional action for eligible rebates—fees and corresponding credits will appear as separate line items on your account activity once processed.

### What counts toward the monthly cap

- Fees assessed for out-of-network ATM usage that are charged to your account are counted toward the $25 monthly rebate limit.

## How fees are calculated

- Domestic out-of-network usage: Each withdrawal is charged $1.00.
- Foreign ATM withdrawals: The fee is 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $2.50. If the percentage-based amount is less than $2.50, the $2.50 minimum applies.

## Examples

- Domestic, multiple withdrawals:
  - If you make several out-of-network withdrawals in a month, each is charged $1.00. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees will be rebated up to a total of $25 for that month.

- Foreign withdrawal:
  - For a single international withdrawal, your fee is calculated at 1.5% of the withdrawn amount, subject to a $2.50 minimum. The applicable amount is charged at the time the transaction is processed.

## Tips to reduce fees

- Consolidate cash needs into fewer withdrawals to limit per-transaction charges of $1.00.
- Monitor your monthly total of out-of-network ATM fees to understand how close you are to the $25 rebate cap.
