title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

## Quick Reference: Fees Discussed Here

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

## Quick Reference: Fees Discussed Here

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

  → This reassures customers that the allocation is embedded within fees (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00) rather than added on top.

  → This is the universal baseline requirement for any dispute, regardless of fee type.

  → This tailors the documentation requirement to the waiver dispute, linking evidence directly to the eligibility criterion.

  → This specifies the identifiers needed to locate and validate a wire transaction during a dispute.

  → This ensures reviewers can verify both the transaction occurrence and the accuracy of the percentage/minimum calculation, including any operator surcharge.

  → This directs customers to the correct submission path, closing the loop on the dispute process.

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

## Quick Reference: Fees Discussed Here

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

A domestic wire fee review requires three pieces of information: the wire date, the wire amount, and the reference number.

A customer contacts support to dispute a fee charged on a domestic wire transaction. Before the fee review can proceed, what details must be gathered from the customer?

The representative must collect the wire date, the amount of the wire, and the reference number. These identifiers are necessary to locate and validate the wire transaction during the dispute.

Why does Hunter Green require the wire date, amount, and reference number when processing a domestic wire fee review?

[END]

During a domestic wire fee dispute, what role does the reference number play alongside the wire date and amount?
[END]
[ANSWER]
The reference number, together with the wire date and amount, acts as one of the key identifiers used to locate and validate the specific wire transaction involved in the dispute.
[END]

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges

## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

## Quick Reference: Fees Discussed Here

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

## Quick Reference: Fees Discussed Here

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

## Quick Reference: Fees Discussed Here

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

## Quick Reference: Fees Discussed Here

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

## Quick Reference: Fees Discussed Here

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

title: Troubleshooting: Hunter Green Fees and Charges
content:
## Identify and Resolve Unexpected Charges

Use the sections below to diagnose why a fee posted, how it’s calculated, and what to do if you believe it’s incorrect.

---

## Monthly Maintenance Fee

You were charged $25.00 if the account did not meet the waiver criteria for the statement period.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Confirm your statement period and check the “Fees & Charges” section for the $25.00 line.
- Verify whether your balance met the waiver threshold of $5,000 for the period.
- If you recently moved funds near the end of the cycle, the timing of deposits/withdrawals may have affected the period-end balance used to determine the waiver.
- If you believe your balance qualified for the waiver but the fee posted, request a review and include your statement period and balance details for the period.

Tips to avoid future charges:
- Keep your balance at or above $5,000 throughout the statement period.
- Set internal alerts to notify you before the cycle ends if your balance is trending below $5,000.

---

## Domestic Wire Transfer Fee

An outgoing domestic wire triggers a fee of $15.00.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Review your transaction history for outgoing domestic wires on the date the fee posted.
- Check whether a team member initiated a wire or if a scheduled/recurring wire executed.
- If you see multiple fees for a single wire, compare timestamps and reference numbers; submit both entries for review if they appear duplicative.

How to avoid:
- Where possible, consider alternative transfer methods for domestic payments that do not incur the $15.00.

---

## ATM Fees

### Domestic out-of-network ATM usage
- Fee: $2.00 per transaction when using non‑Rho ATMs within the U.S.
- You may also see a separate surcharge from the ATM operator; this is set by the ATM owner.

Troubleshooting steps:
- Match the ATM withdrawal date/time and location to the fee posted.
- If you were using an in-network ATM but still see $2.00, provide the ATM address and receipt for review.

### Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals
- Fee: 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00.
- In addition, the ATM operator may add its own surcharge.

How the fee is calculated:
- The fee is the greater of:
  - Withdrawal amount × 2.5%
  - $4.00

Examples:
- Withdrawing 80.00 in local currency equivalent: 80.00 × 2.5% = 2.00; minimum $4.00 applies, so the fee is $4.00.
- Withdrawing 400.00 in local currency equivalent: 400.00 × 2.5% = 10.00; since this exceeds $4.00, the fee is 10.00.

If a foreign ATM fee looks incorrect:
- Confirm the final settled withdrawal amount (in USD equivalent) used for the percentage calculation.
- Check for any separate ATM-operator surcharge on your receipt.
- If you see both a foreign ATM fee and a domestic out-of-network fee for the same international withdrawal, share the transaction details for review.

---

## Sustainability Allocations Within Fees

Some fees on Hunter Green include a carbon-offset allocation. If you see a note or line item indicating a contribution tied to a fee:
- This does not increase the total you pay beyond the published fee amounts (e.g., $25.00, $15.00, $2.00).
- If you believe a separate charge was added in error rather than noted as an allocation within an existing fee, share the statement line items for review.

---

## Quick Reference: Fees Discussed Here

| Charge type                          | Amount/Calculation |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Monthly maintenance fee             | $25.00 |
| Waiver threshold (per period)       | $5,000 |
| Domestic wire (outgoing)            | $15.00 |
| Domestic out-of-network ATM         | $2.00 per transaction |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal              | 2.5% (minimum $4.00) |

---

## Requesting a Fee Review

Provide the following to expedite resolution:
- Statement period and the specific fee(s) in question
- For maintenance fee reviews: balance evidence relative to $5,000 during the period
- For domestic wire fees: wire date, amount, and reference
- For ATM fees: date/time, location, receipt (showing any operator surcharge), and the withdrawal amount used to compute the fee

Submit this information through your usual Rho support channel.

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

| --- | --- |

| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

document:
1. **The Gold Savings Account requires a minimum balance of $10,000 to remain in good standing.**
  → This establishes the baseline eligibility condition, making the $10,000 threshold the central requirement for account holders.

  → This links the minimum balance requirement to a financial penalty, clarifying that the measurement point is the end-of-day balance.

3. **The account earns an APY of 5.5% on the maintained balance.**
  → This is the core earning feature of the account, quantifying the return the depositor receives for keeping funds in the account.

4. **Interest accrues on eligible balances.**
  → This clarifies that earnings are not automatic on all funds—only balances that meet eligibility criteria generate interest.

5. **Interest earnings are tied directly to the stated APY of 5.5%.**
  → This connects the accrual mechanism to the advertised rate, ensuring the account holder understands what determines their earnings.

6. **The monthly maintenance fee is $10.00.**
  → This quantifies the primary cost of the account, giving account holders a concrete figure for potential charges.

7. **The monthly maintenance fee is charged only if the balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period.**
  → This is a conditional fee structure—the fee is avoidable entirely by maintaining the minimum balance, which is a key incentive.

8. **This account tier incurs transfer fees.**
  → This signals an additional cost dimension of the account, indicating that moving money is not free at this tier level.

9. **Account holders can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.**
  → This defines the transactional flexibility of the account, setting a clear ceiling on monthly withdrawal activity.

10. **Exceeding the monthly withdrawal limit may result in transaction denials or delays.**
  → This explains the consequence of surpassing the limit, warning account holders that extra withdrawals are not simply permitted with a fee.

11. **Withdrawal restrictions apply until the next period resets.**
  → This clarifies that blocked or delayed transactions cannot be resolved immediately—account holders must wait for the monthly cycle to renew.

12. **Internal transfers carry fees.**
  → This reiterates the transfer cost within the Transfers section, emphasizing that even moving money between accounts at the same bank is chargeable.

13. **Transfers can be initiated from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking.**
  → This provides practical guidance on how to perform transfers, pointing users to digital banking channels.

14. **Account holders can confirm transfer details before submitting.**
  → This highlights a built-in safeguard in the transfer process, reducing the risk of errors before money moves.

15. **The quick reference table confirms an APY of 5.5%.**
  → The summary table reinforces the earning rate, providing a one-stop verification of the account's headline yield.

16. **The quick reference table confirms a minimum balance of $10,000.**

  → The table ties the fee directly to the condition of not meeting the minimum, making the penalty and its trigger easy to see together.

  → The table consolidates the withdrawal restriction, allowing prospective account holders to quickly assess transactional limits.

19. **The quick reference table confirms that transfer fees apply.**
  → The table's final row reiterates that transfers are not free, ensuring this cost is not overlooked when evaluating the account.

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

  → This clarifies that blocked or delayed transactions cannot be resolved immediately—account holders must wait for the monthly cycle to renew.

  → The table consolidates the withdrawal restriction, allowing prospective account holders to quickly assess transactional limits.

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

  → The table consolidates the withdrawal restriction, allowing prospective account holders to quickly assess transactional limits.

  → The table's final row reiterates that transfers are not free, ensuring this cost is not overlooked when evaluating the account.

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

  → This establishes the baseline eligibility condition, making the $10,000 threshold the central requirement for account holders.

2. **If the end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, the account holder may incur a monthly charge.**
  → This links the minimum balance requirement to a financial penalty, clarifying that the measurement point is the end-of-day balance.

3. **The account earns an APY of 5.5% on the maintained balance.**
  → This is the core earning feature of the account, quantifying the return the depositor receives for keeping funds in the account.

4. **Interest accrues on eligible balances.**
  → This clarifies that earnings are not automatic on all funds—only balances that meet eligibility criteria generate interest.

5. **Interest earnings are tied directly to the stated APY of 5.5%.**
  → This connects the accrual mechanism to the advertised rate, ensuring the account holder understands what determines their earnings.

6. **The monthly maintenance fee is $10.00.**
  → This quantifies the primary cost of the account, giving account holders a concrete figure for potential charges.

7. **The monthly maintenance fee is charged only if the balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period.**
  → This is a conditional fee structure—the fee is avoidable entirely by maintaining the minimum balance, which is a key incentive.

8. **This account tier incurs transfer fees.**
  → This signals an additional cost dimension of the account, indicating that moving money is not free at this tier level.

9. **Account holders can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.**
  → This defines the transactional flexibility of the account, setting a clear ceiling on monthly withdrawal activity.

10. **Exceeding the monthly withdrawal limit may result in transaction denials or delays.**
  → This explains the consequence of surpassing the limit, warning account holders that extra withdrawals are not simply permitted with a fee.

11. **Withdrawal restrictions apply until the next period resets.**
  → This clarifies that blocked or delayed transactions cannot be resolved immediately—account holders must wait for the monthly cycle to renew.

12. **Internal transfers carry fees.**
  → This reiterates the transfer cost within the Transfers section, emphasizing that even moving money between accounts at the same bank is chargeable.

13. **Transfers can be initiated from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking.**
  → This provides practical guidance on how to perform transfers, pointing users to digital banking channels.

14. **Account holders can confirm transfer details before submitting.**
  → This highlights a built-in safeguard in the transfer process, reducing the risk of errors before money moves.

15. **The quick reference table confirms an APY of 5.5%.**
  → The summary table reinforces the earning rate, providing a one-stop verification of the account's headline yield.

16. **The quick reference table confirms a minimum balance of $10,000.**
  → The table restates the balance requirement, ensuring consistency between the detailed sections and the at-a-glance summary.

  → The table ties the fee directly to the condition of not meeting the minimum, making the penalty and its trigger easy to see together.

18. **The quick reference table confirms a monthly withdrawal limit of 20.**
  → The table consolidates the withdrawal restriction, allowing prospective account holders to quickly assess transactional limits.

19. **The quick reference table confirms that transfer fees apply.**
  → The table's final row reiterates that transfers are not free, ensuring this cost is not overlooked when evaluating the account.

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide

- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

  → This is the core earning feature of the account, quantifying the return the depositor receives for keeping funds in the account.

  → This connects the accrual mechanism to the advertised rate, ensuring the account holder understands what determines their earnings.

6. **The monthly maintenance fee is $10.00.**
  → This quantifies the primary cost of the account, giving account holders a concrete figure for potential charges.

  → This clarifies that blocked or delayed transactions cannot be resolved immediately—account holders must wait for the monthly cycle to renew.

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

  → This signals an additional cost dimension of the account, indicating that moving money is not free at this tier level.

  → The table consolidates the withdrawal restriction, allowing prospective account holders to quickly assess transactional limits.

| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
content:
## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |
